snippet.title: SEED OF NOSTALGIA - Official Gameplay Trailer 2026 - NEW #jrpg #indiegame
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1894140/Seed_of_Nostalgia/

Our official upload of the new Seed of Nostalgia gameplay trailer which premiered at the INDIE QUEST showcase.
Step into the world of Seed of Nostalgia, a story-driven JRPG that fuses the soul of 16 and 32-bit classics with modern design and thoughtful quality-of-life features. Explore the breathtaking island Continent of Sylvara — a land of ancient legends and celestial mysteries — Will you peer through the veil and uncover its truth?

Late Pledges and Pre-Orders available on Kickstarter or our Backerkit store:

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/primitivepixels/seed-of-nostalgia
Backerkit: https://seed-of-nostalgia.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders

Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/G5f7H2KUcd

Trailer music and Original Soundtrack by: Mushra at Mushra Games
Itch: https://mushragames.itch.io/
X: https://x.com/jrpgcomposer

Key art by Marcel Mosqi
Bsky: https://bsky.app/profile/mosqi.bsky.social
